title: Customer Feature Exchange and Priority Credits Marketplace
creator: Priya Raman
description: Create a lightweight marketplace where top accounts can submit, exchange, and trade "priority credits" for roadmap items. The intent is to formalize high-touch intake into a transparent ledger that Sales/Customer Success can use when negotiating commitments. This is a narrow, pilot-focused system: a catalog of candidate features, an exchange UI to offer credits, and a back-office view for PMs to accept/decline and log commitments. The pilot targets 5 lighthouse accounts and integrates with existing intake Slack+Confluence workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Pilot UI allows account owners to submit a request with a chosen credit offer and priority tier
Back-office view shows active offers, historical trades, and links to dependent engineering tickets
Sales/CS can export a compact commitment ledger CSV for contract teams
Integration with intake Slack channel posts new offers to #top-account-intake with metadata
Pilot metrics dashboard tracks offers made, offers accepted, time-to-decision, and estimated revenue impact
notes: Rationale: recurring problem where top-accounts expect visibility and negotiable priority. Existing ad-hoc emails/PRs create scope ambiguity and untracked commitments.
Scope for pilot: no automated billing or contract changes. Priority credits are advisory tokens logged in Redwood systems and surfaced to PMs and AE/CS reps.
Trade-offs discussed: building full marketplace (complexity) vs. simple ledger (velocity). We choose ledger-first; marketplace UX can follow if pilot validates demand.
Operational guardrails: limit pilot to 5 accounts and <= 3 active offers per account to keep reviewer load manageable.
Data model note: minimal event log (offer_created, offer_updated, offer_accepted, offer_rejected). Persist user, account, credit_count, TTL, comment.
Success criteria: 3 accepted offers within pilot window OR reduction in escalation cycle time by 25% for participating accounts.
